history_target.derivation: rounded median raw-edge count among the 24 pre-existing N=2048 WP-F0 histories

cross_edge_bundle.construction: add exactly 312 unique cross-chain edges with source layer below target layer to the 2016 chain-cover edges
cross_edge_bundle.fit: OLS over every observed (log(p), log(L)) pair with L>=8, matching the WP-F0 implementation for comparison

d2_conflict_projection.coordinates: independent uniform light-cone coordinates (u,v) in [0,1]^2, ordered by u+v
d2_conflict_projection.access_mode: every assigned resource is both read and written
d2_conflict_projection.conflict_frontier: same RAW/WAW/WAR last-writer/readers-since-write update as DependencyDAG.add
d2_conflict_projection.selection_metric: absolute error of median raw edges/event from 1.13671875 only

n_inventory.included: v16b_dependency_edges.csv plus every Documentation/*fine_dependency_edges.csv paired to its run summary
n_inventory.excluded: files whose schema names coarse_event_id because they are coarse quotient DAGs, not fine event DAGs
n_inventory.fit: descriptive log(Theta) on log(N), separately by arm; grouped history bootstrap

reported_variants: WP-F0 weighting: one deterministic p=1 observation and 20 observations at every p<1
literal at-least-20-per-p weighting: 20 observations at every level

bootstrap_unit_audit.comparison: within-p draw bootstrap versus history-cluster bootstrap

claim_limit: Synthetic generator checks and finite stored-history measurements only; no physics inference and no new UniverseSimulation dynamics.
